articles.headline: Eliminating Nondeterminism in LLM Inference with Integer-Only Arithmetic

When two numbers with very different exponents are added, the small one has to be shifted to line up with the big one, and the digits that fall off on the end are gone. That means that (a+b)+c is not always equal to a+(b+c). This post looks at what happens when integer addition, which is exact, is used.

articles.headline: Elastic Ethereum
articles.blurb: An ethresear.ch opinion post argues Ethereum should replace its fixed slot time, gas limits, and pipeline depth with measurement-driven elastic parameters, drawing an analogy to TCP congestion control's adaptive window mechanism, which scales the same protocol across four orders of magnitude of link speed. Xatu telemetry from 233 instrumented nodes over 100,548 mainnet blocks (October 27–November 9) shows median propagation reaches 95% of nodes in 0.38s, but late-head rates range from 1.7% on company nodes to 11.0% on individual contributor nodes, and 250–260 KiB blocks take 0.61s versus 0.34s for 50–60 KiB blocks. The author maps Ethereum's mempool to TCP's send buffer and orphaned blocks to packet loss, identifying slot time (EIP-7782, EIP-8198), gas-limit votes, and parallel pipelining via Rapidblocks as adaptive knobs, with EIP-8288 mempool aggregation as an elastic interval candidate.

Heavy rain and strong south-westerly winds arrived first in the Portuguese island of Madeira, before the system headed towards the mainland on 11 November. A wind gust of 84.5mph (136 km/h) was recorded at Funchal airport, alongside rainfall totals reaching 355mm (13.97in) in 12 hours. In Lisbon, 183 flights were cancelled on Wednesday, about a third of its normal daily traffic, while Madrid Barajas airport had 155 cancellations. After causing widespread flooding in Spain and Portugal, the system moved on a north-easterly track through southern France and then towards northern Italy. This resulted in significant flooding in parts of Cannes, some of which caused rock falls and led to the closure of roads along the French Riviera. The Italian weather service issued a red rainfall warning, its highest level, for the area extending from Tuscany to Venezia. Further heavy rain is expected to fall in Italy and the Balkans over the next few days, with the latest forecast models indicating an additional 100mm could accumulate widely, while totals close to 200mm are likely in more mountainous areas.
